# Pulse task #2746: Stage local Hex updates while running and apply on quit or one save-and-restart

Operation: 07b6c1961fc45369e6cfcca2873e2fbd
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

PLANNING ONLY — requested design/backlog, not authorization to implement, sign, install, restart, publish or deploy. Keep todo. Reuse existing signing/permission owner #2745 / PR355; no duplicate TCC diagnosis or privacy changes.

Goal and restart budget
Prepare a complete verified optimized local update while the existing hex process keeps running. Offer “install on quit” or one explicit “save and restart”. Staging needs zero restarts; install-on-quit adds zero extra restart cycles (next ordinary launch loads the update); apply-now requires exactly one successful app quit/relaunch, never an OS reboot or live native-code patching. Do not quit before all preparation succeeds.

Inspected baseline (17 October 2026)
Primary source f81a33f993b588faf9aa3a747cf6b1006e3c249f was clean. Installed optimized 0.1.0 source2530036399889929bca64d69f78204ee85b2a88a is still linker-ad-hoc signed, with no TeamIdentifier and a cdhash-based designated requirement; this is not stable signing or notarization. Current docs/test-builds.md and scripts/hex-test-build.py already provide exact-source local CI, release build, Cargo artifact/cache ownership, stable target artifacts/hex.app, org.portalsurfer.hex.dev, resource hashes/native signature checks, serialized verified publication and minimal temporary previous-app custody with retry. They refuse a running app BEFORE building, and do not provide independent pending updates or deferred application. Do not claim those features already exist. #2408/PR167 and #2627/PR246 remain completed history; #2705/PR321 preserves fast ordinary startup.

Reviewable design
1. Split repository-owned preparation from publication. An explicitly requested preparation runs required exact-candidate local checks and optimized compilation in an immutable source checkout, then validates the complete candidate. Keep one fixed owned pending-candidate location outside both the running app and the existing publication-custody directory; never launch a second review bundle. Bind its metadata to source/tree digest, included PR heads, profile, resource hashes, configured target, signing requirement and selected candidate. Partial/failed preparation leaves the installed app and current session untouched. No automatic CPU-heavy build/CI while recording; background execution does not prove audio-deadline safety.
2. “install on quit” queues that exact verified candidate for a normal, successful app shutdown. A narrow repository-owned helper/supervisor may outlive that process solely to finish the requested install; no login item, persistent deployment daemon or arbitrary execution channel. Do not interpret timeout, crash or missing save acknowledgment as approval. Recheck exact process/session identity, no remaining bundle instances, pending selection, target identity, locks, hashes and signing immediately before replacement. Publication lock covers apply, not the entire background build; existing Cargo target locks still cover builds.
3. “save and restart” needs a REAL asynchronous save-and-quit path. Current editor/close.rs has guarded request_quit/request_window_close and Cancel/Discard, not a save-and-restart facility. Reuse canonical save/Save As and wait for durable completion; Cancel, failed saving, pending destructive work or active gain recording must leave the running app and update pending. Never synthesize Discard or force-quit. Stop/quiesce existing audio/control workers through desktop lifecycle, then wait for process exit before touching the bundle. Relaunch once only when explicitly requested; optionally reopen the successfully saved project through existing validated open contracts, with no promise to preserve currently nonpersistent undo history.
4. Reuse the current checked publication/recovery transaction: install only at /Users/portalsurfer/dev/hex/artifacts/hex.app, same executable/bundle identity, verify after replacement, retain the last usable app only in temporary custody until publication is verified, then remove that custody. No retained new rollback-app copies or cleanup of historical bundles. Failed apply must keep/restore the usable installed app and report actionable retry/status; no automatic project-format rollback or data migration. Normal quit must not unexpectedly relaunch the app.
5. Keep ./launch as fast installed-app startup without Git/CI/build or implicit update installation. Explicit test/update preparation remains opt-in. GPUI displays simple lowercase “update ready”, “install on quit”, “save and restart” states; provenance stays in receipts/logs. Desktop owns lifecycle, existing session owns project saving, workers/tools own filesystem/build work; no waiting or I/O in the audio callback.
6. Use #2745’s completed stable existing signing-identity contract; do not create another certificate/key or signing configuration. Local iterations do NOT require an Apple notarization submission each time. Same path and bundle ID alone cannot guarantee Documents access: preserve compatible stable designated requirement/team plus owner-verified folder/bookmark behavior. One-time transition from ad-hoc signing may still require genuine macOS user consent. Never reset TCC, change library permissions or enable Full Disk Access as an updater remedy.

Finite acceptance
- Prepare two successive optimized candidates while old hex runs; old process/app files remain unchanged until approved shutdown.
- Cancel/failed save/pending work/active recording leave app and projects intact; process death without approved close does not silently consume the update.
- Apply after one normal quit; manual restart action completes one quit/relaunch only. Concurrent launcher/installer, another instance, superseded candidate, signature/hash/identity mismatch, unwritable target and interrupted publication have deterministic refusal/retry tests.
- Verify exact running artifact/source after relaunch, same path/bundle/signing requirement, unchanged settings/projects/media and a preserved Dock target. With #2745’s owner, grant Documents sample access once and test two stable-signed rebuilds; record OS behavior rather than promise universal TCC permanence.
- Required local-only CI and optimized native candidate evidence; real user-owned save/cancel/relaunch and permission checks separately recorded. No native automation overlapping the user.
- Preserve historical releases and all current launch/installer safety regressions.

Dependencies and sources
Advisory dependency #2745/PR355 (stable signing/permission investigation). New direct-distribution updater is separate future work.
Pinned source: https://github.com/PORTALSURFER/hex/blob/f81a33f993b588faf9aa3a747cf6b1006e3c249f/scripts/hex-test-build.py ; https://github.com/PORTALSURFER/hex/blob/f81a33f993b588faf9aa3a747cf6b1006e3c249f/crates/hex-ui/src/editor/close.rs ; docs/test-builds.md and launch at the same commit.
Apple code identity/updates: https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/technotes/tn2206/_index.html . Apple DTS confirms ad-hoc build identity churn for screen-capture permissions; applying that to this Documents report remains #2745’s diagnosis, not updater proof: https://developer.apple.com/forums/thread/819406 .
No source edits, installations, certificate/key creation, TCC changes, hosted CI, servers or updater implementation are authorized by this planning record.
